judgement.overall_note: The production update correctly preserves nearly all carryover items and adds one new agreement bullet about the trigger-evaluator gap, which is grounded in the dialog. However, it significantly under-represents the new agreements: four distinct gold agreements about the concerns-to-ReAct activation gap are compressed into a single vague bullet, losing the original design intent clarification, the derived-concerns-as-step detail, the latent-vs-active framing, and the translation mechanics. More critically, the gold-required modification to the 'Expand agent capabilities' active commitment is missed entirely—the active commitments section is dropped from the new state altogether. The identified architectural problem (trigger-evaluator) is named but not adequately elaborated as a set of mutual agreements.
